name: Citizenship by Marriage (Exempt from Standard Naturalisation Requirements)

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a citizen of the Republic of Armenia -- exempts the applicant from am_naturalisation.json's standard 3-year permanent-residence and Armenian-language requirements, but an application is still required (marriage alone does not automatically confer citizenship).
Must have attained the age of 18 and have active legal capacity.
May be rejected if the applicant's activities harm state security and public safety.

sources.title: ARLIS -- Law on the Citizenship of the Republic of Armenia, Article 13: marriage to an Armenian citizen exempts the applicant from the standard residence and language requirements, though an application remains necessary

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). Gender-neutral on its face -- Article 13 refers to marrying 'a citizen of the Republic of Armenia' without specifying the sex of either spouse, unlike some other countries' marriage-based citizenship provisions built earlier in this dataset (e.g. Morocco, Oman). No minimum marriage-duration figure (e.g. '3 years married') was found in the text reviewed -- the exemption appears to apply from the marriage itself, though this was not stress-tested against edge cases (e.g. marriages of convenience safeguards) in this pass, disclosed as an open question rather than assumed absent.
